name: McCrae Yacht Club
signature: A compact bay sailing club at McCrae — active racing program and a tight-knit community between Rosebud and Safety Beach
editorNote: McCrae Yacht Club is a smaller, community-focused sailing club on the bay at McCrae — one of those Peninsula institutions that runs quietly and well without much fanfare. Active racing program through the season, junior sailing in summer.
whyWeGo: A genuine local sailing club — the Peninsula's sailing community at its most compact and community-focused.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check their racing calendar — club racing on the bay at McCrae is a relaxed way into Peninsula sailing.
